title: Adding parties through supplemental jurisdiction
summary: The pendent-party problem asks whether a related claim against or by an additional person may be heard when that person’s claim has no independent federal jurisdictional basis.
notes: Kroger’s concern with an original plaintiff’s claim against a nondiverse third-party defendant is reflected in the later statutory restrictions. Distinguish that claim from the defending party’s own derivative impleader claim.

sections.Meaning: The pendent-party problem asks whether a related claim against or by an additional person may be heard when that person’s claim has no independent federal jurisdictional basis.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the anchor claim, the new party’s procedural role, the joinder rule, and the statutory limitations. Compare the historical decisions with § 1367’s text rather than assuming that factual overlap alone answers the question.
